detached_structure.evidence: Small structures sit behind the central house near the upper left, but they are on or near the neighboring lot boundary and the ownership is unclear. A small shed-like object also appears in the rear yard just above the house.

signals.notes: Central ranch-style house with a gray composite roof and a paved driveway on the right side leading to the street; the rear yard is partly shaded by large mature trees and a tall hedge borders the left side.
